charts.title: HAT-P-54 b: orbits around HAT-P-54
charts.description: The orbits of HAT-P-54's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HAT-P-54 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Hewitt et al. 2024 (2024JAVSO..52..137H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HEWITT_ET_AL__2024): P 3.79985363 d

charts.title: HAT-P-54 b: its transit
charts.description: HAT-P-54 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 71, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 284326455, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 7-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
